dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Seeking: 'Vera's Melancholy - The Final Chapter.' Willing to pay a fair price. Thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Forget it. I've been searching for it for years too. No one knows if the author's alive or dead — chances are they're dead. If you really want the ending, you'll have to find someone to finish it."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "In that case, how about you write 'Vera's Melancholy - The Final Chapter.' Thanks in advance."
